text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I had no shell tool here, so I found them by reading the code against the tests. Please run the suite to confirm it passes.

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3. It is now 5, which matches the lending-policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`:** the fee was `days_late + DAILY_FEE`. It is now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing the book "Emma". I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copy count are my guess, since the tests only check the title.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one in the slice. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.
